title: British Fish Wrap
description: A crispy, flavorful British-inspired fish wrap filled with flaky fish and crunchy slaw.
instructions: 1. In a shallow dish, mix together Worcestershire sauce and a pinch of salt and pepper.
2. Dip the flaked cod into the Worcestershire mixture, coating both sides completely.
3. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add a small amount of oil.
4. Add the cod to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
5. Meanwhile, prepare the slaw by mixing together the coleslaw mix, mayonnaise, and chopped parsley in a bowl.
6. Warm the quick wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
7. To assemble the wrap, lay the warmed wrap flat and add a few leaves of lettuce.
8. Place the cooked cod on top of the lettuce, followed by a spoonful of the slaw.
9. Add the crispy fried onions on top of the slaw.
10. Fold the wrap in half and serve immediately.
